finite_maximality_review.domain: Nonnegative float32 command bit ranks from +0 through q0, signed zero canonicalized to +0; no NaN/Inf. At most 31 binary decisions per rank boundary; no enumeration
finite_maximality_review.signed_force_proof: With frozen finite state, source-ordered round-to-nearest add/subtract/multiply-by-positive/divide-by-positive operations preserve gas monotonicity including ramp plateau. Brake fixed engine-updated omega approaches0 monotonically as q increases, including min and >=0.9 lock branch. Signed long force is monotone, possibly in the opposite direction per wheel
finite_maximality_review.norm_proof: For fixed lateral demand, source norm, division by fixed positive limit, subtraction1 and max0 are V-shaped in signed monotone long force. Overflow/nonfinite violates the certified domain
finite_maximality_review.strict_or_threshold_interval: Locate signed force zero crossing on integer ranks; inspect its neighboring ranks and endpoints for a passing minimum. Bisect left and right monotone branches using the exact executed excess(q)<=threshold predicate; intersect four closed integer rank intervals. Empty versus certification failure are different outcomes
finite_maximality_review.threshold_search: For repaired objective, nonnegative finite float64 bit ranks from0 through observed M(q0) bound a monotone existence search. At most63 threshold bisections locate the smallest representable threshold with nonempty intersection; recompute its maximal-q witness, objective identity and excluded neighbor. Do not replace excess<=threshold with rounded norm<=limit*(1+threshold)
finite_maximality_review.work: Bounded adaptive finite probes, roughly <=63*4*3*31 wheel predicate evaluations plus endpoints/witness checks; an implementation must set and measure its own hard operation/CPU cap. No full float32 scan or real-root rounding plus one check
